WITH product AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pv.brand)) = LOWER(TRIM('Metabo'))
    AND LOWER(TRIM(pv.series)) = LOWER(TRIM('Metabo Brushless BS 1OW-IK5 Cordless Drill Driver'))
),
props AS (
  SELECT pvp.product_sku
  FROM product_variant_properties pvp
  WHERE pvp.product_sku IN (SELECT product_sku FROM product)
    AND (
      (LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_key)) = LOWER(TRIM('voltage')) AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM('18 V')))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_key)) = LOWER(TRIM('battery platform')) AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM('18v-system')))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_key)) = LOWER(TRIM('kit contents')) AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM('bare tool')))
    )
  GROUP BY pvp.product_sku
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pvp.property_key) = 3
)
SELECT p.product_sku, p.record_path
FROM product p
WHERE p.product_sku IN (SELECT product_sku FROM props);

SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) AS available_today_quantity
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON s.store_id = si.store_id AND si.product_sku = $product_sku
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s.city)) = LOWER(TRIM('Graz'))
ORDER BY s.store_id;
